scripts.copy: mkdir -p www/vendor && cp *.html app.js www/ && cp vendor/* www/vendor/
scripts.sync: npm run copy && cap sync android
scripts.build:android: npm run copy && cap sync android && cap build android
scripts.build:apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build:aab: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
